tips.title: Thinning Vallejo Model Air for Airbrushing
tips.text: Use a 1:3 ratio of Vallejo Model Air to Vallejo Airbrush Thinner (71.261) for optimal airbrush performance. This dilutes the paint to a thin, consistent mist. Add 1-2 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver (71.230) per 10 drops of thinner to enhance flow. Test spray on a white plastic spoon — if the paint forms droplets, add more thinner. Spray at 1.0-1.5 bar pressure. Avoid mixing with Model Color, as their base formulas differ significantly.

tips.title: Base Coat with Tamiya 1/32 Primer
tips.text: Apply two thin layers of Tamiya 1/32 Primer (13341) using a brush for even coverage. Allow 30 minutes drying time between coats. Use a Tamiya plastic cement (10103) brush for precise application. Prime all surfaces, including seams and panel lines, to ensure base coat adhesion. Avoid over-brushing to prevent paint bleed through the primer layer. For metallics, apply primer first then spray with Tamiya Model Color (71.230).

tips.title: Camouflage Masking with Eduard Masking Tape
tips.text: Use Eduard 1:35 Camouflage Masking Tape (72454) to create sharp, clean patterns. Apply with a Tamiya brush (10112) and Tamiya Masking Tape Adhesive (10115) for strong adherence. Cut tape with a hobby knife (Tamiya T-200) for precise shapes. Remove tape immediately after painting to avoid residue. For multi-color camo, use separate masks for each color to prevent paint bleed between sections.

tips.title: Applying Washes with AK Interactive Pigment Wash
tips.text: Mix AK Interactive Pigment Wash (11048) with water at a 1:3 ratio for a thin, liquid consistency. Apply with a soft brush (Tamiya 10043) using light, even strokes. Focus on recessed areas and panel lines for depth. After drying, use a Tamiya brush (10112) to wipe away excess wash. For a more intense effect, use Flory Models Pigment Wash (11147) with a 1:2 ratio for heavier application on textured surfaces.

tips.title: Gloss Coat Before Decals with Clear Prop Models
tips.text: Apply a thin gloss coat of Clear Prop Models Gloss Varnish (73726) using a Tamiya brush (10112) or airbrush (0.2mm nozzle). Ensure the surface is completely dry before applying. Use a soft cloth (Tamiya 10044) to wipe off excess varnish for a smooth finish. Allow 15 minutes drying time. This creates a smooth base for decals, ensuring they adhere without bubbles or wrinkling. Apply two coats for maximum adhesion and clarity.
